findings.problem: RouteWorkflow has no typestate enum; any combination of is_validated and is_sent is reachable, including validated+sent without ever being created, or sent+validated (backwards transition), or neither flag set after construction
findings.failure_mode: callers can construct RouteWorkflow with contradictory or impossible lifecycle flags, enabling invalid state transitions that break downstream invariants such as audit trails or message ordering guarantees
findings.fix: replace is_validated: bool and is_sent: bool with an enum RouteState { Draft, Validated, Sent } and make mark_sent accept RouteState::Validated and return RouteState::Sent via a new RouteWorkflow

findings.problem: status field is a String that is set to literal "sent" in mark_sent, but is never validated, canonicalized, or constrained to a known set of lifecycle values
findings.failure_mode: callers can set status to any arbitrary string ("SENT", "", "cancelled", "sent_pending") making status a meaningless field and enabling silent state corruption that cannot be pattern-matched on
findings.fix: replace status: String with a sealed enum RouteStatus { Active, Sent } and remove mark_sent string assignment

findings.problem: is_validated: bool and is_sent: bool are independent booleans encoding lifecycle state; there is no enforced transition ordering and no single source of truth for the lifecycle
findings.failure_mode: a RouteWorkflow can be is_validated=true and is_sent=false after construction (never validated then sent), or is_validated=false and is_sent=true (sent without validation), or both true without a defined transition path, making lifecycle invariants unenforceable
findings.fix: merge is_validated and is_sent into a single typestate enum RouteState with ordered variants; remove both bool fields entirely

findings.problem: sent_at_epoch_ms: Option<u64> is an independent optional field that can be Some(...) while is_sent=false, or None while is_sent=true, with no invariant enforcement tying the timestamp to the sent lifecycle state
findings.failure_mode: audit timestamps can be present for non-sent routes or absent for sent routes, breaking time-based queries, SLA tracking, and any assumption that sent_at_epoch_ms is meaningful only when the route is in the sent state
findings.fix: move the timestamp into the typestate enum variant: RouteState::Sent { sent_at_epoch_ms: u64 }, making the timestamp present only when and because the route is sent

findings.problem: id: String is a raw String with no domain semantics; it can be empty, contain arbitrary Unicode, duplicate values, or be used interchangeably with other String fields
findings.failure_mode: route IDs can be empty strings, duplicated across instances, or confused with other string fields in the domain, leading to ambiguous lookups, duplicate routing, and silent data corruption
findings.fix: introduce a non_empty newtype: pub struct RouteId(pub String); provide a smart constructor that rejects empty/whitespace and returns a typed error; use RouteId instead of String

findings.problem: mark_sent takes a fully-constructed RouteWorkflow by value and mutates it in place without any parse boundary validation; raw primitives cross the parse boundary without fallible smart constructors, so callers can construct invalid domain states directly
findings.failure_mode: any caller can invoke mark_sent on a RouteWorkflow in any arbitrary internal state (invalid flags, empty id, missing timestamp on sent), and the function silently accepts and mutates the invalid state instead of rejecting it at the boundary
findings.fix: replace mark_sent with a fallible smart constructor fn try_mark_sent(route: RouteWorkflow, now_ms: u64) -> Result<RouteWorkflow, RouteError> that validates the current typestate, checks id non-emptiness, and returns RouteError::InvalidState, RouteError::InvalidId, or RouteError::Allocation

no allocation evidence (try_reserve, Vec::with_capacity audit, or bounded collection proof)
no command evidence (cargo fmt --check, cargo clippy, cargo test) was run or reported
no workload description or performance baseline for any throughput/latency claims
residual_risk: Static review only; no commands run. The RouteWorkflow struct is fundamentally broken as a domain model — all six typestate fields are representable in illegal combinations. No enforcement mechanism exists at any boundary. The only fix is a complete typestate refactor of RouteWorkflow with a sealed lifecycle enum, newtyped IDs, and fallible smart constructors at the parse boundary.
